items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So in the back of my mind I was thinking -- because you know, I love Lorraine, you know.

ctx.x: So he said, 'Okay, but you're still a drag.' So he goes and gets Lorraine and brings Lorraine down the next night. So Lorraine says, 'Kenny, I'd like to talk to you.' So in the back of my mind I was thinking -- because you know, I love Lorraine, you know. So Lorraine says, 'Now, listen Kenny, we need you to make this trip. It's very important. It's going to be a very important trip, and we would like for you to
make it." Then I began to think, you know. I said, "Now, what is this." You know. So before the night was over I told her okay, I'll go.
